shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,240p' package.json && sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml && rg --files specs src/orchestration/tools | sort && sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' src/types/ai.ts && rg \"@spec|spec:\" src/**/*.test.ts | head -40 && rg --files scripts/spec-links scripts 2>/dev/null | sort | head -80"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg \"specs/.+#\" src scripts --glob '*.test.ts' | head -30 && sed -n '1,100p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts | nl -ba | sed -n '1,110p' && sed -n '1,160p' scripts/check-spec-links.mjs"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -0 | xargs -0 -r -n1 sh -c 'echo \""'$0"; sed -n "1,240p" "$0"'"' && rg \"validated by:\" specs -n | head -20"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npm install --ignore-scripts --save ajv@''^8.17.1 && npm pkg set version=0.4.0 && npm install --ignore-scripts --package-lock-only'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md package.json package-lock.json && node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs --help 2>&1 | sed -n '1,100p'"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs origin/main && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- package.json src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md && git status --short'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,100p' CHANGELOG.md && sed -n '1,130p' package-lock.json && git diff -- package-lock.json | sed -n '1,220p'"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write CHANGELOG.md && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md package.json package-lock.json specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "feat(tools): compile static input schemas" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git status --short --branch'
